title: 环境与资源词汇
goal: 识别环境与资源词汇，并理解节约措施及其条件。

points.label: 识别环境资源词汇及搭配
读懂环境措施与实际影响的关系

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）

body.p: 环境与资源话题常讲能源使用、污染治理和资源保护。读到一项措施时，先看它在什么条件下起作用，再看实际影响。

body.box: Turning off an unused lamp saves electricity while the lamp is off.

body.p: 措施是关掉不用的灯，影响是关灯期间省电。while the lamp is off 限定了省电的时段。

body.box:
A family replaced a broken lamp with an efficient one. The new lamp gives the same amount of light while using less electricity during the hours it is on. The family also turns it off when the room is empty. The first change reduces electricity use while the lamp operates; the second avoids use during periods when no light is needed. Neither measure describes the electricity used by other appliances in the home.
What is the effect of turning off the lamp in an empty room?
1. It avoids using electricity for that lamp while it is off.
2. It stops every appliance in the home from using electricity.
3. It makes the lamp consume more power while it is on.
4. It provides the room with light while the lamp is off.

body.p: the second avoids use during periods when no light is needed 说明关灯省下的是这盏灯在无人时的用电。第一项保留了对象和关灯期间这一条件。第二项扩大到家中所有电器，原文没有说明其他电器的用电。

groups.fill: A community collects glass for reuse. Volunteers re{use} empty ja{rs} and ch{eck} them f{or} damage bef{ore} placing th{em} on she{lves} in t{he} shared ro{om} each we{ek}. Residents can take the jars home and return them after use. A damaged jar is kept out of the reuse collection. The group also labels the shelves so that people can distinguish clean jars from those waiting to be washed.
notes: reuse：前句的 reuse 说明玻璃罐被再次使用。
jars：后文说明居民取走并归还玻璃罐。
check：check them for damage 表示检查是否损坏。
for：check for damage 是检查损坏。
shelves：后文提到架子上有标签。

groups.text:
A small office wanted to use less water without making its kitchen difficult to use. Staff first checked the taps and found one that continued to drip after it was closed. They arranged for it to be repaired. They also placed a container under the tap until the repair was completed, then used the collected water for plants.

The office compared its water bills over several months, but the number of people working there also changed. For that reason the bills alone could not show exactly how much water the repair saved. Staff recorded the date of the repair and kept notes about other changes in the building.

The office did not ask everyone to stop using the kitchen. Instead, it put a reminder near the sink asking people to close taps properly. The reminder could help only when people noticed and followed it. Staff agreed to check the taps regularly and replace a reminder if it became difficult to read. The purpose was to reduce unnecessary use while keeping water available for washing and other ordinary tasks.

items.stem: Why did staff arrange to repair one tap?
options: It kept dripping after it was closed.
It could not provide water for plants.
It was difficult for staff to close.
People forgot to close it properly.
items.why: found one that continued to drip after it was closed 说明修理原因。

items.stem: What did staff do with water collected before the repair?
options: They used it for kitchen washing.
They used it to water plants.
They measured it to check the bills.
They stored it for the whole year.
items.why: used the collected water for plants 是收集水的用途。

items.stem: Why could the bills not show the exact saving from the repair?
options: The office stopped keeping any bills.
Staff did not record the repair date.
The office's staff numbers changed too.
The plants needed less water after the repair.
items.why: 工作人员数量也发生变化，因此账单无法单独显示修理的准确影响。

items.stem: Under what condition could the reminder help?
options: When the kitchen remained closed
When it was replaced every week
When staff checked the taps regularly
When people noticed and followed it
items.why: could help only when people noticed and followed it 给出条件。

items.stem: What was the office trying to achieve?
options: Less waste while keeping water for ordinary tasks
No water use for washing or other kitchen tasks
Less water use by closing the kitchen to staff
An exact record of the water saved by the repair
items.why: 末句说明减少不必要用水，同时保留日常用水。

groups.fill: A school is trying to use fewer new sheets. It reu{ses} its pa{per} for no{tes} and recy{cles} old she{ets} to red{uce} the wa{ste} of fi{ber} in sch{ool} every d{ay}. Recycling here means collecting sheets and sending them to a service that makes new paper. Teachers provide separate boxes for used paper and other waste. They also remind students to use both sides of a sheet when suitable. The program relies on people placing the paper in the correct box.

groups.text:
A neighborhood center wanted to reduce electricity used for lighting in its meeting rooms. The rooms had large windows, but the lights were often left on even when daylight was sufficient. Staff began by asking room users to switch off unnecessary lights. They also placed switches near the doors so that users could reach them when entering or leaving.

One room had separate switches for the lights near the windows and those farther inside. On bright days, a group could turn off the lights by the windows while keeping the inner lights on. The center did not assume that this would work in every room or in every season. People still needed enough light to read and move safely.

After several weeks, staff checked the rooms at different times and asked users whether the lighting was adequate. They found that one room was too dark for reading when all its lights were off, so they reminded groups to leave the necessary lights on. Another room was often empty with its lights on, and a notice by its door helped remind the last person to switch them off. The measures were intended to avoid unnecessary electricity use while maintaining useful lighting.

items.stem: What did the center ask room users to do?
options: Leave every light on throughout the day
Switch off lights that were not needed
Cover all the windows during meetings
Move the switches away from the doors
items.why: asking room users to switch off unnecessary lights 说明对使用者的要求。

items.stem: What did separate switches allow a group to do on a bright day?
options: Turn off window-side lights but keep inner ones on
Turn off inner lights while keeping window-side ones on
Turn off every light because daylight was enough
Switch off the lights by the door when leaving
items.why: 原文说明可关闭窗边灯，同时保留内侧灯。

items.stem: What condition did the center consider when using daylight?
options: Every room had identical windows and switches.
Users could read safely with all lights off.
People still needed adequate light for safe use.
Daylight was sufficient in every season and room.
items.why: People still needed enough light to read and move safely 给出条件。

items.stem: Why were groups reminded to keep necessary lights on in one room?
options: The room had no switches near its door.
The room was often empty with its lights on.
The room had separate switches for each side.
The room was too dark for reading without lights.
items.why: one room was too dark for reading when all its lights were off 是提醒的原因。

items.stem: What was the purpose of the notice by the other room's door?
options: To tell users to leave necessary lights on
To remind the last user to switch off the lights
To ask users to keep the empty room illuminated
To ask users whether the lighting was adequate
items.why: notice by its door helped remind the last person to switch them off 说明通知用途。
